# Medical Regulations
Medical Regulations are laws that medical personnel must follow, this also includes security's Corpsman.
[textlink="DNRs" link="DNRs"] stand for Do Not Resuscitate. This can only be done by paperwork.
[textlink="Medical Evaluation" link="MedicalEvaluation"] is the ability for the Chief Medical Officer [bold]to declare someone on-duty unfit for their position. This also includes the Commanding Officer, considering there is good medical reasoning and documentation.
Medical personnel have the ability to [textlink="prescribe medicine" link="PrescribingMedicine"] to patients in cases where short-term treatment within medbay is not feasible. All prescriptions given out by medical require a valid prescription document, signed and stamped by a medical professional.
[textlink="Quarantine" link="Quarantine"] is the right of Medical personnel to put someone under Quarantine if there is a viral outbreak.
[textlink="Foreign Bodies" link="ForeignBodies"] are the regulations concerning parasitic entities.
[textlink="Surgical Regulations" link="SurgicalRegulations"] are the regulations governing how surgerical operations should be performed, including sanitation and consent.
[textlink="Handling of Entity Remains" link="HandlingOfEntityRemains"] covers the proper handling of remains, including disposal and last wishes.
